OPGAVE DER WINDEN IN HET JOURNAAL GEBEUR: The winds in the journal are recorded in points of the compass with variation (uncorrected for magnetic variation). Wind force is indicated in numbers. The value of the numbers is as follows: 1. Light breeze, enough to have steerage way in the ship. 2, 3 and 4. Gentle breeze, with which a good ship, with all sails set, makes from 1 to 2, from 2 to 3 and from 3 to 4 miles per watch. 5. Topgallant-sail breeze. 6. Topsail breeze. 7. Reefed topsail breeze. 8. Double-reefed topsail breeze. 9. Close-reefed topsail breeze. 10. Lower-sail breeze (courses only). 11. Storm. 12. Hurricane. In the column of observed variations one wishes to find recorded only those observed on board, and not those that can be found on the charts. For Mr. Maurij one follows some particulars and one must state whether they take longer or shorter over it because of them.
